justification: A shows a single ambiguous painted blob, roughly an elongated shape with a projecting lobe that might be read as a crude animal or limb, with no other elements; B shows a dense, ordered programme of low-relief animals in profile (crouching quadrupeds, long-necked birds, a snake-like sinuous form), a row of repeated schematic heads along the top and a horizontal banded register. Beyond the bare possibility that both contain a creature, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement: A is a single isolated silhouette with no internal detail, B is a multi-register composition with articulated eyes, limbs and framing bands.
